attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as the router for the shared private network 10.100.34.0/24 with node2/node3: gave it a fixed static address (kept its existing 10.100.34.10 to avoid breaking the exec transport), enabled its dnsmasq DHCP server to serve node2/node3 (required setting dhcp.lan.force='1' since dnsmasq initially detected and deferred to the platform's own DHCP server present on the same L2), and added a firewall rule rejecting TCP/23 from the lan zone. Verified all three settings live via actual traffic tests (nmap broadcast-dhcp-discover from node2/node3 showing node1 as a DHCPOFFER source; nc showing TCP 23 refused while TCP 22 still succeeds), both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time, confirming a changed boot_id and full functional recovery on each node.
